name: 瞌睡王
evolution: 白发懒人 → 动力猿 Lv.18 → 瞌睡王 Lv.36
description: 比较难找到它的眼睛，主要靠鼾声来判断它是不是醒着。即使危险就在面前也能睡得香香的，或许是强大的体格给了它这样做的底气。
descriptionEn: Its eyes are rather hard to find, so people mainly rely on its snoring to tell whether it is awake. It can sleep soundly even with danger right in front of it — perhaps its powerful build is what gives it the confidence to do so.

skills.name: 寸拳
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; recovers 1 energy for itself.

skills.name: 晒太阳
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels all of the enemy's buffs.

skills.name: 化劲
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +40 power to all of its own skills.

skills.name: 压扁
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 气沉丹田
skills.description: 自己回复60%生命，获得物攻+130%，每次应对后本技能能耗-3，使用后能耗重置。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 60% of its own HP and gains physical attack +130%. After each counter, this skill's energy cost is -3; after use, the cost resets.

skills.name: 回旋踢
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. If the enemy switches creatures this turn, this skill's power is doubled.

skills.name: 斩断
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. In countering state: additionally interrupts the countered skill.

skills.name: 应激反应
skills.description: 自己回复25%生命，应对防御：改为回复50%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 25% of its own HP. Countering a defense: recovers 50% HP instead.

skills.name: 技巧打击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. In countering state: this skill's power becomes 10 times.

skills.name: 偷袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. In countering state: this skill's power becomes 3 times.
